label: first copy-phase step (echoing orig token 0) in long sequences
explanation: Fires essentially only in the copy phase, at the step right after <DEL> where the input is the fed-back first original token and the model outputs original token 1 (recall_idx == 1; 93% of activation mass). Rate and magnitude rise strongly with sequence length: rare for L<=5, partial for L=6-7, near-always for L>=8 (L>=8 precision 0.99). Magnitude is further modulated by the identity of the first token (n, y, j, 2, w give the largest activations). Weaker, lower-magnitude spillover at recall_idx == 2 (about 7% of mass) and a tiny tail at the last copy steps of L=8-9 sequences. Never fires in the original phase or at the <DEL> step itself.

issues: All factual claims check out on the dev split. Every activation is in the copy phase, with only 5 on the <DEL> step. recall_idx==1 holds 92.7% of mass and recall_idx==2 holds 7.2%. The firing rate at recall_idx==1 by L is: L=5 10%, L=6 32%, L=7 77%, L=8 98%, L=9 100%. The largest first-token effects are n, 2, j, y and w. The tail at recall_idx 7-8 is tiny.

There are two systematic but minor gaps, and both are already disclosed. (a) recall_idx==2 fires on 41% of L=9 steps and 18% of L=8 steps, about 7% of mass. These steps go up when the fed-back previous token is one of the strong first tokens. (b) At L=6, recall_idx==1 fires for strong first tokens (n/y/j/2/w), and the base predicate misses these.
Most false positives on test are recall_idx==1 at L=7 with a weak first token (for example h, t, i, e, f, o). That matches the token dependence described in the explanation.
The phrase 'first copy-phase step' is consistent with phase==2 starting at t>L. Note that the model's first output (orig 0, recall_idx 0) is on the <DEL> step, where the unit is silent.
Adding the first-token condition for L=6 and the recall_idx==2, L=9 spillover lifts test F1 from 0.799 to 0.822, which clears the explained bar.
skeptic.revised_label: step right after <DEL> (input = orig token 0) in long sequences (L>=7, or L=6 with a strong first token), with weak spillover to the next step at L=9
